summary: The document's preparers concur with the engineering staff's assessment, concluding that an aerial system would virtually destroy the park and that mitigation would require major route relocation to Sunset Boulevard or a transition to a subway alignment in that area.
text:
Such an aerial system would virtually destroy the park. Mitigation of these impacts would necessitate major route relocation to Sunset Boulevard or transition from an aerial alignment to a subway in this
area. Cut and cover construction would be practically impossible in this location.
